description: This Java class 'TenantDatabaseStateVerifier' provides methods to verify the state of tenant database migrations using Liquibase and Flyway, including checking if migrations are on the latest version and if Liquibase is enabled.

classes.name: TenantDatabaseStateVerifier
classes.description: A component class that verifies the state of tenant database migrations, including checking migration versions and Liquibase status.

methods.name: isFirstLiquibaseMigration
methods.description: Checks if the database is at its first Liquibase migration by verifying the presence of the 'DATABASECHANGELOG' table.

methods.name: isFlywayPresent
methods.description: Checks if the Flyway schema version table exists in the database.

methods.name: isLiquibaseDisabled
methods.description: Determines if Liquibase is disabled based on configuration properties.

methods.name: isTenantStoreOnLatestUpgradableVersion
methods.description: Checks if the tenant store database is on the latest upgradable Flyway version.

methods.name: isTenantOnLatestUpgradableVersion
methods.description: Checks if the tenant database is on the latest Flyway version.

methods.name: isOnLatestFlywayVersion
methods.description: Helper method that verifies if the database has applied the latest Flyway migration with specific version, script name, and checksum.
